column1: # Star Citizen: game terms voices get wrong. written<TAB>spoken, optionally
# <TAB>languages (comma-separated codes) when the spoken form only fits some.
# Digits in the spoken form are fine: they are read in the spoken language
# afterwards ("F 7 C" becomes "F sieben C" in German).
# German voices would read "U E C" as German letters; players say these
# terms in English, so the German lines spell the English sound. The first
# matching line wins, so the German one comes first.
# Everything but aUEC is switched off for now: the spelled-out letters broke
# the flow of speech, and we are listening to what the model says on its own.
# Lower case: capitals made the voice stress every letter (+2.9 dB against
# +1.1 dB in the sentence around it, measured 2026-09-24).
